title: Resources
intro: Links, forms, PDFs, and the tools the team uses.

items.title: BAND invite
items.note: Join requests are approved by an admin.

items.title: Be Class
items.note: Student and parent page. Sign up at the church site. Next class is Sunday, October 18, 2026. Third Sunday of every month. Time and room are not posted yet.

items.title: Open Floor
items.note: Live question floor for a panel or a small group. Students join with the code or QR. No account. The leader sets a 4-digit PIN.

items.title: BAND
items.note: Where the student ministry shares weekly updates and sign-ups (for example, the Oct 7 prayer-night bus). The invite link and code are in the BAND invite card above.

items.title: PAKA by DYM
items.note: Free small group toolkit app from Download Youth Ministry: ice-breakers, Would You Rather, low-prep games, a people picker and a scorekeeper. Get it on iOS or Android.

items.title: Sword Drills (Bible team game)
items.note: Open on the TV/projector, then join from your phone with the code or QR on the screen. Tables, Classic/Themed mode and a Wildcard round.
